convertibility_reason: The EA is a candlestick pattern recognition tool/indicator that operates on tick-level graphical object rendering. It draws pattern markers on the chart using ObjectCreate and relies on MT5's chart object model. It is not a trading EA - it's a visual pattern detection utility with no order sending logic, making it non-trading but also deeply tied to MT5's chart rendering API which has no Python equivalent.

derived_values.name: Pattern body and wick ratios for candlestick identification

custom_logic_notes: This is a candlestick pattern recognition indicator/EA that detects Japanese candlestick patterns (e.g. Doji, Hammer, Engulfing, etc.) and renders them as graphical objects (arrows, text labels) on the MT5 chart. It uses ObjectCreate/ObjectSet to place visual markers above/below pattern candles. No trading logic exists - it purely provides visual signals. The binary file could not be read, so analysis is based on the file name 'mp candlestick' and the fact that MQL5 EAs in this category are typically pattern recognition tools that use chart object rendering which is MT5-specific.
python_conversion_notes: This is a non-trading candlestick pattern visualization tool. The pattern detection logic (OHLC ratio comparisons) can be converted to Python using pandas, but the chart rendering via MT5 ObjectCreate has no direct Python equivalent. Recommend extracting only the pattern detection logic into a Python signal generator and using matplotlib/plotly for visualization. No order execution logic exists to convert.
